description: Deregisters an NF Instance or Shared Data resource from the NRF via DELETE on the corresponding resource URI.

constraints.statement: The NF Service Consumer shall send a DELETE request to the resource URI representing the NF Instance.
evidence: The NF Service Consumer shall send a DELETE request to the resource URI representing the NF Instance.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required HTTP method and target resource for NF Instance deregistration.

constraints.statement: The request body for NF Instance deregistration shall be empty.
evidence: The request body shall be empty.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable request payload constraint.

constraints.statement: On successful NF Instance deregistration, the NRF shall return 204 No Content.
evidence: On success, "204 No Content" shall be returned.
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the required success status code.

constraints.statement: The response body for successful NF Instance deregistration shall be empty.
evidence: The response body shall be empty.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable response payload constraint.

constraints.statement: If the NF Instance identified by nfInstanceID is not found in the NRF database, the NRF shall return 404 Not Found.
evidence: If the NF Instance, identified by the "nfInstanceID", is not found in the list of registered NF Instances in the NRF's database, the NRF shall return "404 Not Found" status code with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required error handling for a missing NF Instance.

constraints.statement: A 404 Not Found response for missing NF Instance deregistration shall include ProblemDetails providing details of the error.
evidence: ...the NRF shall return "404 Not Found" status code with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies a required error payload element.

constraints.statement: In case of redirection for NF Instance deregistration, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code.
evidence: In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return 3xx status code, which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required class of redirect response.

constraints.statement: A redirection response for NF Instance deregistration shall contain a Location header pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
evidence: ...which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable redirect header requirement.

constraints.statement: The NF Service Consumer shall send a DELETE request to the resource URI representing the Shared Data.
evidence: The NF Service Consumer shall send a DELETE request to the resource URI representing the Shared Data.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required HTTP method and target resource for Shared Data deregistration.

constraints.statement: The request body for Shared Data deregistration shall be empty.
evidence: The request body shall be empty.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable request payload constraint.

constraints.statement: On successful Shared Data deregistration, the NRF shall return 204 No Content.
evidence: On success, "204 No Content" shall be returned.
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the required success status code.

constraints.statement: The response body for successful Shared Data deregistration shall be empty.
evidence: The response body shall be empty.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable response payload constraint.

constraints.statement: If the Shared Data identified by sharedDataId is not found in the NRF database, the NRF shall return 404 Not Found.
evidence: If the Shared Data, identified by the "sharedDataId", is not found in the NRF's database, the NRF shall return "404 Not Found" status code with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required error handling for missing Shared Data.

constraints.statement: A 404 Not Found response for missing Shared Data deregistration shall include ProblemDetails providing details of the error.
evidence: ...the NRF shall return "404 Not Found" status code with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies a required error payload element.

constraints.statement: If the Shared Data is not authorized with write access to the requesting NF, the NRF shall return 403 Forbidden.
evidence: If the Shared Data is not authorized with write access to the requesting NF (e.g. the Shared Data is shared to one specific NF Set while the requesting NF is not in that NF Set), the NRF shall return "403 Forbidden" status code with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required authorization failure response.

constraints.statement: A 403 Forbidden response for unauthorized Shared Data deregistration shall include ProblemDetails providing details of the error.
evidence: ...the NRF shall return "403 Forbidden" status code with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies a required error payload element.

constraints.statement: In case of redirection for Shared Data deregistration, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code.
evidence: In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return 3xx status code, which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required class of redirect response.

constraints.statement: A redirection response for Shared Data deregistration shall contain a Location header pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
evidence: ...which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable redirect header requirement.
